This Memorandum of Agreement is effective on October 27, 2002 and shall expire on October 22, 2005. The parties specifically agree that the terms and conditions set forth in this Memorandum of Agreement shall also terminate on October 22, 2005 and shall not survive the expiration of this Memorandum of Agreement unless agreed to by the parties in writing.
